same_move_rule: The side with the larger corresponding stat hits; equal stats cause no damage.
damage_rule: Damage equals the winning move's energy/crunch/ability stat.

special_modifiers.condition: Player Digimon type is ancient and is being hit
special_modifiers.effect: Enemy energy, ability, and crunch are each round(value / 2) before damage.
Player energy, ability, and crunch are each max(0, value - 120) before damage.

enemy_move_filter.algorithm: All moves except the previous enemy move are always candidates; the previous move is retained only when irandom(100) > 50, then one candidate is random.

element_usage: No battle calculation references `.element`; it is used by database/spirit UI only.
